Merge sort recursively sorts halves and merges them. Quicksort partitions around a pivot
and sorts partitions.
Merge sort එක array එක Jදෙකට Jබදෙලා sorted halves නුවතෙ එකතු කරනවා. Quicksort එක pivot එකකට සාJපේක්ෂව values Jබදෙනවා. Pivot Jතේරීම performance එකට බලපානවා.

merge([1,4],[2,3]) gives [1,2,3,4]. Merge sort Θ(n log n); quicksort expected Θ(n log n),
worst Θ(n²).
When might merge sort be preferred?
When predictable O(n log n) time and stability are important.
